scenes.summary: Yvonne adds the inspiration she acquired to her graffiti but still believes it is not yet perfect enough. She invites you to one final place.

lines.text: He's out on patrol. The dude's pretty busy and doesn't have time to keep his eyes on us.
We'll finish the final part of the graffiti and get out of here before Mr. Fabian comes back!
Hmm. I finished the painting but ... it lacks the final breath of life. It's not perfect enough...
I think ... it's missing something. What do you think, Endmin?
So ... Endmin —
Join me. We got one last place to visit.

options: Fabian is going to arrest you.
Something you want to "scream" about.

scenes.summary: The crew mates tell you that a few Aggeloi made it to the underground production floors. Yvonne is certain she can take care of them.

lines.text: Wait. I see UWST crew mates... Did something happen?
Yvonne? And the Endmin? Why are you here?
A few Aggeloi busted their way onto the underground production floors. We don't know how many rock buggers there are...
Fff. Aggeloi? Since we're going down there anyways, my Mini-Bombtails will take care of them for you.
Shouldn't we wait for a while? UW reinforcements are arriving soon.
lines.who: Calm Crew Mate {c17m3- Calm Crew Mate}

lines.text: Come on, stop being so wishy-washy! Things will get a lot worse if the Aggeloi start breaking apart the machinery downstairs.
But...
lines.who: Calm Crew Mate {c17m3- Calm Crew Mate}

lines.text: Heard that! Thus spake the Endministrator! Leave your problems in our capable hands and worry no longer.
Then we should stay in touch. I'll notify our Security Bureau that you're heading down.
Alright, Endmin. Time for a cleanup job!
Now we got trouble on our hands...

options: Don't worry. Yvonne and I will take care of it.

lines.text: Frost-e-Bytee is prepped. Tweety-Bomb readings look normal. And my pewpews ... have plenty of ammo.
Let's go, Endmin!
Great. Now, stay really close, and try not to get lost!
Fine. Just hurry up because time doesn't wait for anyone!

options: I'm fully prepared as well.
I'll need some time to prepare.

scenes.summary: Yvonne tells you that she worked here before and she intends to head to the lower floors for inspiration. This is when you find traces of Aggeloid activity.

lines.text: Professor Crowe divvied out that assembly module for me. Funding was pretty scarce so we had to make do with second-hand machines.
But don't belittle them. Plenty of new UWST tech came from here. Your tools don't matter much. As long as you got the vision and technique, you can "paint" the perfect work.
Now I'm itching to head to the lower floors for more inspirations. This is it! Time to finish our magnum opus.
Hmm. Just like before — Huh?!
Endmin, it's those Aggeloi! They're moving as a cluster!
Frost-e-Bytee! Let's ice these rocky crawlies!
That alarm light has been activated!
The intruders might be over there. Endmin, we should let Frost-e-Bytee scout the way for us.
I worked here before I got my own lab.

options: You're right.
Where are we headed next?

scenes.summary: You restart the elevator together. During the dialog, Yvonne mentions that she was the only user of this entire area.

lines.text: I've acquired controls of the elevator. Now I just need a command to activate it.
Heheh. I was probably the only one using this area... So I'm actually quite familiar with the machinery and where everything's stored.
Let's keep going, shall we?
Follow me close.
Go ahead. Admire all the fabulous works I've stored here.
Hmm. I feel better alone, though. UWST crew mates are decent company, but when your visions don't match, you just don't get along.
I got my Tweety-Bombs and Frost-e-Bytee. So, I never felt lonely. Heck, I even have you people around nowadays!
Just a few discarded plans... But they're feasible, you know. Maybe they'll become useful one day. That's why I kept them around.
I'll never work on meaningless design plans.
Aww... These guys are just...
Su ... per ... ite ... rator...

options: You hacked the thing really quick.
Yeah. Let's go!
I want to look around some more.
The only one? Wouldn't you feel alone?
Did you make all these on your own?

scenes.summary: After defeating the Aggeloi, Yvonne walks up to a door but hesitates. With your encouragement, she decides to go in with you.

lines.text: Mmmh-ahhh. The Aggeloi party is finally over!
Endmin...
Feels great finding inspiration with you, Endmin. I think ... this should be far enough for us.
Time to head back!
Okay... Then let's head in together!
Identification success. Locks disengaged.

options: Not going in?
You seem troubled by something.
I'm right beside you, no matter what happens.

scenes.summary: The room is where Yvonne first worked on Tata. She shares her feelings with you and the secret about the paint. She originally ordered the paint to give Tata a new coating.

lines.text: That's right. This ... is where I first started working on Tata.
In the end ... it did everything for me. It protected my friends ... and ensured everyone lived peacefully ever after.
I wanted it to protect the latest Witching Hour fashion, popular music albums, and upcoming movie sequels from New Wrankwood... Something capable of keeping everyone safe.
I don't know when it changed for me. I just wanted Tata to do more than that... I was hoping for a day when it could level with me ... and maybe even become my one and only companion?
It was the best baby bot in the world... But ... I ... I never knew what it was thinking about... I even failed to protect it...
Initially, I treated it as a vessel for conveying my ingenious ideas, a masterpiece capable of ending the Ætherside threat.
I uploaded a massive amount of data about Valley IV into Tata... Was it the data that drove its final choice? Or the wishes that I forced it to take on?
And when it made its choice... I ... I wasn't even there...
I got no use for these coating paints. Not anymore...
Yeah. New coating for Tata. But they ... they arrived a little too late.

options: This place must be...
Is this where you first designed Tata?
So the paints were actually meant for...
They turned out to be Tata's coating.

scenes.summary: Yvonne tells you she's alright. You prepare to leave the place.

lines.text: ...It's time to go.
This place...? Yeah. It brought back plenty of memories. But ... I'm alright. No need to worry about me.
I'm ready to head up. How about you, Endmin?
Good. Let's get going. Better not leave the crew mates waiting for too long.
Sure... Just try to be safe, k?

options: This place means a lot to you.
Thanks for taking me here.
Let's go.
I still want to look around the place.

scenes.summary: You reach the surface from the underground production floors and run into Fabian Collins. Yvonne tells him that she will wash away the graffiti, but Fabian informs her that everyone actually likes the lively work and hopes to see it complete.

lines.text: {F}They're coming back up!{M}They're coming back up!
lines.who: Calm Crew Mate {c17m3- Calm Crew Mate}

lines.text: Hooo. I knew you'd be alright.
Much appreciated. Seems like we're racking up a serious debt of gratitude.
Oh, Yvonne, about that graffiti...
Okay, okay. I confess. I drew that thing... And I'll clean it up according to procedure.
No, that's not what I was trying to say... Sure we have our SOPs ... and everyone knows you drew it. But Aleeza told me that everyone kind of likes it.
So, that graffiti is half-done, right?
I was about to ask if you could finish it.
Wha? Are you alright?! Did some Landbreaker knock you on the head during their attack...?
*Sigh* Aleeza said the same thing. Do you really treat me as a tedious bore?
The attack really devastated the Park. Morale is at rock bottom.
You've been looking for me ... just to tell me this?
Of course. Ah...! But I must remind you. This is an exceptional case. It doesn't give you permission to do whatever you want!
Nevertheless... You and your TA-TA saved everyone in the Park, and did so many things for us...
Everyone else hopes to see you and offer their gratitude in person too.
Endmin, I ... I'm not really good at handling a situation like this — HELP!
Really?
But that work of yours is a true spectacle. People are really happy to see it and hope it can be completed. Your work has breathed life into the Park and everyone's thankful.

options: Got rid of the bugs in your basement.
You can take over the cleanup work.
You got tons of friends!
Just say hi and you're welcome!
First time?

scenes.summary: Yvonne tells you that she will restore Tata but she still feels a little sad. You comfort her and she gets back to her feet, and brings you to her lab.

lines.text: Why am I sniveling again ... hngh...
{F}It also happens to me from time to time.{M}It also happens to me from time to time.
*Sniffs*... Really...? I don't believe it...

{F}It's a distant dream. And when I wake, I always fail to remember what the dream was trying to tell me.{M}It's a distant dream. And when I wake, I always fail to remember what the dream was trying to tell me.
{F}But the tears never lie. I constantly feel that there's someone out there ... waiting for me...{M}But the tears never lie. I constantly feel that there's someone out there ... waiting for me...
...Stop saying things like that.
It sounds like you'll be heading somewhere far away ... and never come back.
{F}Not just me. The entirety of Endfield. We're all headed towards a faraway destination.{M}Not just me. The entirety of Endfield. We're all headed towards a faraway destination.
That's right. No one's gonna let you do this alone. There's me and everyone else. And —
Oh, we got some time left. Follow me, Endmin!
Sorry, Endmin... I actually thought about drawing Tata when the paints arrived.
I collected all the smiles in Valley IV and, with my own hands, gave it the perfect smile emote... There's no way I could forget...
Left us?! What do you mean?! I won't allow that!
I'm gonna restore it! And this time, I'll protect it! I won't let it leave me again... *hik*!
But I was scared that my drawings wouldn't match my memories... Scared that my drawings wouldn't look anything like Tata...

options: All of us found it hard to accept that Tata had left us...

scenes.summary: The defense system is in your way. Yvonne decides to create a shortcut — by activating the transport belt.

lines.text: Heh. You're looking at a defense system that I specifically designed to protect our production lines... It's super reliable!
Ah... Well, yeah... Let me think for a moment.
Heheh... So there was this ... budgetary issue that prevented us from slapping on an emergency kill switch. Yeah ... we probably can't switch it off...
Have no fear! I got an idea.

options: You know how to switch it off, right?
Is this ... navigable?
Did you design this?

scenes.summary: You run into a gate capable of giving a smiley. It was designed by Yvonne as well.

lines.text: I thought about having a gate that greets you when you report to work. It'd start your day with a morale boost.
Sometimes I would think ... that the gate actually looked forward to seeing and greeting me —
Endmin, do you have similar ideas as well?
If machines had emotions ... we'd get a double dose of happiness!
Absolutely correct! The smiley looks like a greeting. Not bad, right?
Hmmhmm... That's it... Done!
Good morning! Good afternoon! And good evening! I'd also smile and respond with: "Hi there!"

options: Yeah. I thought about that before.
Yeah. I've actually seen it before.
This gate is obviously designed by you.

scenes.summary: You encounter defense systems that Yvonne made, and must find a way to overcome the obstacles.

lines.text: Welp ... yeah... But look at it! It's bedazzling, right?
It may look super impressive, but it's got a design weakness. Let's find a way through the middle!
How should we get across... Ah, I got it!

options: Did you build these defenses as well?

scenes.summary: Yvonne thinks about a way to pass through. She needs you to clear the Aggeloi outside while she prepares.

lines.text: Is this the warehouse? Oh, I got it! Endmin, wait here for me.
Heheh. You'll see soon enough. I just got a perfect idea!
I'll handle the path and you'll take care of the Aggeloi outside. The legendary Endmin can definitely pull it off! Go! Go! Go!
{F}Fine...{M}Fine...

options: What's this place...?
But we're almost surrounded by the Aggeloi.
An idea? Now...?

scenes.summary: While waiting for the drones to repair the road, you ask Yvonne about her plans for the future. She tells you she has not figured it out but as an Endfield operator, she will heed your commands. Yvonne also hopes you will lend your support when she runs into problems.

lines.text: Why do you sound like Andre? You're both asking me the same questions...
Truth be told... I got no idea! Sure, I made plenty of plans but I didn't think any of them through.
But I gotta make this clear. If my projects get into trouble, Endmin, please promise me you're on my side.
Enough with the niceties. You've been a great help to me as well, Endmin!
Really? Then you better be mentally prepared.
Great! Let's go!
Oh my goodness. You're far more powerful than I expected... That's a lot of Aggeloi you defeated.
Really? Then promise you'll protect me forever!
Ahem. Enough games for now. Once the drones finish laying down the boards, we'll be able to cross.
Oh... Got it! I'm an Endfield operator now, so I guess I'll be following your orders for a while, Endmin!
I really haven't been back for a while. The problems kept coming, and I totally lost track of time...

options: Yvonne, about these problems we had...
Thanks. You've been a great help to us.
Of course. I'll definitely be on your side.
I gotta keep you safe.
Can't afford to expose a friend to danger.
What are your plans for the future?

scenes.summary: Yvonne is gathering inspiration here when she suddenly asks you about your own plans for the future. Just then, a group of dangerous Aggeloi shows up...

lines.text: Endmin, what about you?
*Sigh* I almost forgot about all that. We're just too different. After all, you're the Endministrator of Endfield Industries —
You're Tata's friend, the protagonist of numerous legends, the hope of the people...
And despite all these super heavy responsibilities ... you still ran all over ... just to do graffiti with me.
Well ... pinky promise! Let's complete that masterpiece together!
Mmhmm. It's a deal, then.
Your plans. For the future. When this is all over, where are you headed next?
You got a blightload of problems to solve every time they wake you up.
How did this huge guy get here?! Endmin, watch out!

options: I have my own mission.
Figure things out. A lot of things.
Because I want to see the complete graffiti.
And I'm happy to help.
Of course.
What about me?

scenes.summary: Yvonne invites you to take part in her Tata Restoration Project. She tells you that she, Tata, and every Endfielder will join you and reach the "faraway destination" together...

lines.text: Tata uploaded some data at the moment of the explosion. This, together with the files from Professor Crowe...
What exactly comprises its "memories"? Language models, cognitive algorithms... If I figure this out and transfer it to a new chassis...
*Sigh* Unfortunately ... Tata was trying to complete its mission ... and didn't have time to upload the backup model...
Endmin, if Tata came back but forgot everything about its journey with us, would it still be Tata?
You're not the same as Tata, Endmin... Fff. I guess you're not that different actually!
You're both a unique phenomenon in this ever-changing world... A novel form of continuous iteration.
I got a new idea, Endmin! Wanna be a co-artist of yet another magnificent work?
No. This isn't just a work. It's our greatest undertaking! Our very own companion!
Endmin, that faraway destination you just mentioned...
We'll reach it together. Me, you, everyone, and of course —
Tata!

options: I forgot a lot of things myself.
Interesting. Is the Endmin still the Endmin?
I'm with you all the way.
Seems like I'll be investing major time in this.

scenes.summary: Elevator access has been locked. Yvonne decides to stay behind to hack the control panel and asks you to search for UWST audio logs to acquire the activation command.

lines.text: This big fella has been abandoned for way too long. Access is locked. We need to restart the control panel and...
Hmm... I think they changed the activation command. Endmin, can you help me look for it?
Check for things like audio logs nearby. They should have the latest command... And let Frost-e-Bytee tag along. It should help you find it.
Take good care of the Endmin —
I'll hack the control panel. You find the command!

options: No problem.
Come on then, Bytee.

scenes.summary: Yvonne introduces the UWST style of design as well as her own style to you. She wants her creations to feel more friendly and human.

lines.text: That's right! The UWST spent years figuring out how to beat the Blight...
Look at these big fellas. I don't know if I should call them rigorously robust or ponderously inflexible... In any case, UWST designs will always do the job.
Unfortunately, the UW-style focuses too much on practicality. Their designs lack that dash of human touch...
TADA — And this is my design, Endmin! Look! Couldn't be more different from the UW approach, don't you think?
People who work with machines for years... Well, they probably feel a little lonely and empty inside. I definitely don't want my machines to feel that way.
That's that. Let's keep moving!

options: These look like UWST designs.

scenes.summary: From the audio logs, the crew mates mention a new activation command: "Super Iterator."

lines.text: Did Yvonne forget to clean out these stuff... Hmm. Is that a giftbox?
There's a memo sticker on the side. Reads: "Parting gift."
*Sigh* The girl really has an attitude and we never stopped arguing. But now that she's gone, I feel like I kinda miss her.
Stop crying. She'll be back if we got another joint project going. Let's leave a backdoor and change the command to ⟦key|"Super Iterator"⟧!
Me? Crying? Stop imagining things!
A UWST crew mate's audio log.

options: Press the play button.

lines.text: Decrypting the Æther energy was a massive undertaking...
I emptied ten crates of bubble coffee just to compute a new constant for the depth stability tests!
Material samples mailed from the Commandery... Impacts from our Originium structures were too strong for conventional D64 Steel.
UWST application procedures can be a real hassle. I would have paid for it out of my own pocket if it'd been available on the market.
Oh. That... I'm surprised they didn't erase it.
I wanted to write a motto here, but got stuck for days.
In the end, I decided to write something simple. Just a self reminder that designs must look good.
Project inception to physical prototyping... I can't remember how many types of material I used during this process.
I brought Tata to plenty of places and met a lot of people. Everyone helped. That's how I got to successfully build Tata.
I disqualified this material because of insufficient toughness... Kept a piece as a memento.
Tsk. The Aggeloi are blocking the exit.
Our weapons probably won't hit those Aggeloi on the high platforms...
Endmin, I'll take out the one perched up high.
{F}What are you planning?{M}What are you planning?
Incoming!
Legacy systems are such a hassle... Endmin, just find that command for me.
Got a new idea, Endmin! I'm reserving a bit of your time —
Heheh. I was just joking!
Well, thanks a million for everything this time. If you need help, or if you're just looking for fun, give me a call. I'll be there!

options: Another graffiti?
Found your inspiration so quickly?

lines.text: Blighted Zone Vehicle Exhibit Guide:
"Designed for deep incursions into Blighted Zones to gather data. Production discontinued due to high costs and frequent decommissioning."
First-Gen Prototype Exhibit Guide:
"The first-gen prototype was decommissioned due to its large size, poor heat dissipation, and power supply issues, making it unfit for practical use."
It underwent thousands of tests, gathering invaluable data for the UWST. Every scar is proof of its effort.
